# Unstop

> Unstop is a comprehensive platform connecting students and corporates with competitions, hackathons, scholarships, internships, and quizzes.

Unstop serves as a central hub for skill development and opportunity discovery, offering both learning resources and hands-on competitive experiences. The platform partners with major corporations like Procter & Gamble, Accenture, and Reliance Industries to provide real-world challenges and career opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Competitions
- Hackathons
- Scholarships
- Internships
- Quizzes
- Student Opportunities
- Corporate Programs
- SQL
- Network Training
- Business Simulations
- Platform Overview
- Browser Requirements
- Privacy & Legal
- Career Development
- Skill Assessment

## Platform Overview

- [Unstop Homepage](https://unstop.com/): Main platform hub offering competitions, hackathons, scholarships and internships for students and corporate professionals

## Learning & Simulations

- [LearnBiz Business Simulations](https://simulations.unstop.com/): Interactive business simulations platform featuring economics, finance and management games for experiential learning
- [SQL Query Guide](https://unstop.com/blog/sql-query): Comprehensive SQL query tutorial covering syntax, types and practical examples by Shreeya Thakur
- [CISCO Packet Tracer Guide](https://unstop.com/blog/cisco-packet-tracer): Features, applications and benefits of CISCO Packet Tracer for network simulation and training

## Legal & Privacy

- [Privacy Policy](https://unstop.com/legal/privacy-policy): Privacy policy detailing data handling practices and browser requirements for Unstop platform access
